summary: Improve CRM data, lead follow-up, and pipeline reporting with practical digital sales tools training. Explore the five-day course.
lede: Digital sales tools and CRM workflows help sales teams keep prospect records accurate and use pipeline activity to guide follow-up. For sales representatives, account executives, sales operations specialists, and CRM administrators, the practical work includes qualifying leads, updating opportunity stages, and checking records for gaps or stale information. Learners also practise Excel-based pipeline reporting and review how automation and AI-assisted prioritization shape lead routing and follow-up decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who work with digital sales tools, CRM records, pipeline activity, or sales performance reporting. This course is designed for: Sales representatives recording prospect interactions and planning CRM follow-up. Account executives qualifying opportunities and maintaining accurate deal stages. Sales operations analysts reviewing pipeline coverage and forecast inputs. CRM administrators configuring sales fields, permissions, and record standards. Business development representatives managing prospect lists and lead handoffs. Key account managers tracking customer activity and renewal opportunities. Sales team leaders reviewing CRM activity, conversion rates, and forecasts. Revenue operations specialists aligning CRM workflows with sales reporting. Marketing operations coordinators transferring qualified leads into CRM pipelines. Customer success managers updating CRM records during account transitions.
modules: CRM Integration and Sales Action Planning
prerequisites: Working familiarity with a sales process and routine use of customer, prospect, or opportunity records is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Bring a laptop with Excel if you want to complete the spreadsheet-based analysis; access to an organizational CRM is optional and should only be used with appropriate data permissions.
